The bull case rests on record third quarter revenue of 1846000000.00 and non-GAAP net income of 531000000.00 which management attributes to rapid scaling of the AI infrastructure ecosystem [D1]. Free cash flow reached 403000000.00, providing the company with additional financial flexibility while it continued to return capital through its share repurchase programme [D2]. Orders surged 56% year-on-year to 2091000000.00, significantly exceeding market expectations and driven by demand for testing solutions linked to artificial intelligence infrastructure [D2]. The Communications Solutions Group emerged as the principal growth driver with commercial communications revenue jumping 56% while wireline revenue surpassed wireless revenue for the first time in company history [D3]. Management raised its outlook for the fourth fiscal quarter of 2026 revenue to a range of 1930000000.00 to 1950000000.00, comfortably above the analyst consensus of 1820000000.00 [D2]. Operating margin expanded by more than 800 basis points compared with the previous year reflecting the benefits of stronger revenue and disciplined cost management [D2]. The stock closed at 333.42, which is below the immediate resistance high edge of 366.41, suggesting potential upside if supply issues resolve [N]. The bull case needs to see that fourth quarter revenue lands within the raised guidance range and that operating margin expansion continues in the next report [D1].

The bear case rests on management cautioning that one-time tariff impacts in fiscal year 2026 will not repeat, creating a high comparison bar for future profitability [D3]. Supply chain constraints are expected to act as a governor on near-term revenue conversion for the next several quarters due to high demand for incoming components across the ecosystem [D4]. The supply environment is less flexible today than a year ago requiring deeper engagement with suppliers to deconstrain production for high-demand new product introductions [D3]. Management stated that supply will be a governor of their ability to convert demand into revenue for the next several quarters [D3]. Analysts expressed concern about whether $2 billion quarterly order levels are sustainable given the current supply constraints [D4]. The stock closed at 333.42, which is above the immediate support low edge of 311.2696 but below the immediate resistance high edge of 366.41, suggesting potential downside pressure if supply issues persist [N]. The bear case needs to see that revenue conversion remains nonlinear and that supply constraints do not cap fourth quarter results in the next report [D3].
